players.bio: Albert Rusnák (born 7 July 1994) is a Slovak professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder and winger for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders and the Slovakia national team. Career Manchester City Rusnák played youth football in Slovakia for MFK Košice from a very young age, before signing for Manchester City in July 2010, where he joined the club's academy side.
Alex Roldan (born July 28, 1996) is an American soccer player who plays for Seattle Sounders FC.
Andrew Delmos Thomas (born September 1, 1998) is a Russian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC.

Antino "Tino" Lopez is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC. Born on 21 May 2002, the 23-year-old defender recently signed a First Team contract with the Sounders through the 2026 season, solidifying his rise through the club's development pathway

Brian Schmetzer (born August 18, 1962) is an American soccer coach and retired player. He is the head coach of the Seattle Sounders FC, who play in Major League Soccer (MLS), having been assistant coach for the team until Sigi Schmid's departure in 2016.

Cristian Roldan (born June 3, 1995) is an American professional soccer player, who currently plays as a midfielder for Seattle Sounders FC in Major League Soccer. Career College and Amateur Roldan was named the 2013 Gatorade National Player of the Year in soccer while attending El Rancho High School in Pico Rivera, California. Roldan spent his college career at the University of Washington.
Daniel Musovski (born November 30, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC.

Hassani Dotson Stephenson (born August 6, 1997) is an American soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Minnesota United FC of Major League Soccer. Career Youth & College Dotson attended Oregon State University, where he played college soccer for four years from 2015 to 2018, making 72 appearances, scoring 5 goals and tallying 3 assists.

Jackson Ragen (born September 24, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who currently plays for Seattle Sounders FC of Major League Soccer. Jackson Ragen (born September 24, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who currently plays for Seattle Sounders FC of Major League Soccer.

Jesús David Ferreira Castro (born December 24, 2000) is a professional soccer player who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC. Born in Colombia, he represents the United States national team. Born in Colombia, Ferreira moved to Dallas, Texas, at the age of 10 after his father, David Ferreira, signed with FC Dallas.

Jordan Perry Morris (born October 26, 1994) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger and forward for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC and the United States national team. He grew up on Mercer Island, Washington and joined the Sounders youth academy before playing college soccer at Stanford University.

Kalani Kossa-Rienzi (born June 27, 2002) is an American soccer player who plays for Seattle Sounders FC in Major League Soccer. Early life Kossa-Rienzi played youth soccer with Mavericks SC. He attended Berkeley High School, where he was named the WACC-Foothill Player of the Year, the North Coast Section Player of the Year, an All-USA Second Team selection, and an All-American, as a junior.

Kim Kee-hee (born 13 July 1989) is a South Korean professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Seattle Sounders FC in Major League Soccer. He can also be fielded as a defensive midfielder. Kim has played for teams in the K-League, Qatar Stars League, Chinese Super League and Major League Soccer. He has also represented South Korea at the national level.

Max Anchor is a 21-year-old Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Seattle Sounders FC in Major League Soccer (MLS). Known for his high potential and towering 6-foot-3-inch frame, he splits time between the senior MLS squad and Seattle's reserve team, Tacoma Defiance, in MLS NEXT Pro.

Nikola Petković (born 23 February 2003) is a Serbian footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer side Seattle Sounders FC, on loan from Charlotte FC. Career At the age of 4, Petkovic began playing football before joining the Bambi Academy at the age of 7. Petković began his career with Čukarički.

Nouhou Tolo (born 23 June 1997), sometimes known mononymically as Nouhou, is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Seattle Sounders FC in Major League Soccer and the Cameroon national team. Nouhou represented Cameroon at the 2021 Africa Cup of Nations.

Osaze Tafari De Rosario (/oʊˈsɑːzeɪ/ oh-SAH-zay; born 19 July 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for MLS Next Pro club Tacoma Defiance. Born in the United States and the son of former Canada national team player Dwayne De Rosario, he plays for the Guyana national team.
Paul Joseph Arriola (born February 5, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC. Arriola spent years with U.S.

Paul Rothrock (born January 9, 1999) is an American soccer player who plays for the Seattle Sounders FC in Major League Soccer. Early life Born and raised in Seattle, Rothrock spent most of his youth career with Seattle United, a partner club of the Seattle Sounders Academy, leading them to two Washington State Cup titles, two Far West Regional titles, and two appearances in the U.S.

Pedro de la Vega (born 7 February 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC. Club career Lanús De la Vega started his career in the youth of Ferrocarril Sud before joining Lanús in 2015, having previously been rejected in trials with Boca Juniors and River Plate.
Peter Kingston (born July 14, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC.

Ryan Joseph Sailor (born November 27, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders. Sailor attended Arapahoe High School, who he helped lead to a Region IV semi-finals and to a Colorado State championship in 2013. Sailor also played club soccer for Real Colorado, where he served as team captain.

Shane Edward O'Neill (born September 2, 1993) is a professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Serbian SuperLiga club Radnički 1923. Born in Ireland, he represented the United States at international level.

Snyder Brunell (born March 27, 2007) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer team Seattle Sounders FC. Club career Born in Plano, Texas, Brunell moved near Redmond, Washington, at the age of 9 and began playing soccer with the Crossfire Premier academy.

Stefan Frei (born 20 April 1986) is a Swiss footballer who currently plays as a goalkeeper for Seattle Sounders FC in Major League Soccer. Frei has played his entire professional career in Major League Soccer.

Stuart Hawkins is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC. Born on September 18, 2006, in Fox Island, Washington, he stands 1.90 m (6 ft 3 in) tall. He plays under a Homegrown Player contract running through 2026, split between the senior MLS squad and their MLS Next Pro affiliate, Tacoma Defiance.

Xavi Gnaulati is a 21-year-old American professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder for Tacoma Defiance in MLS NEXT Pro. Born on 22 January 2005 in San Diego, California, he is widely regarded as an exciting, technically gifted young midfield prospect.

Yeimar Pastor Gómez Andrade (born 30 June 1992) is a Colombian professional footballer currently playing for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC. Club career Gómez made his professional debut for Tiro Federal while on loan from Rosario Central. He made 66 appearances in two and a half seasons with Unión de Santa Fe.
